recipe.visualDefinition: A high-key, sun-drenched portrait of a male musician holding an acoustic guitar, characterized by a weathered, desaturated color palette and classic serif typography integrated into the environment via textured overlays.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's warm skin tones against a cool, blown-out white background
Textured typography overlapping the subject and background elements
Diagonal line created by the guitar neck leading to the subject's face
coreInvariants: High-key lighting with significant white clipping in the background
Visible film grain or grit texture across the entire image
Use of a classic, high-contrast serif typeface

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is positioned in the right two-thirds of the frame, medium shot from waist up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's smiling face and eyes serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the top-left text, moves down the guitar neck, and rests on the subject's face.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy use of bright, overexposed negative space in the upper left and top background.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Desaturated whites and light grays in the background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep teals and dark browns in the guitar and clothing.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm tan and cream tones in the text background and skin highlights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the subject and the background.

letterConstructionRules: High stroke contrast between thicks and thins

composition.relationshipToImage: Integrated with a semi-transparent textured block

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Same typeface family with varying weights and tracking for hierarchy.
graphicDevices: Semi-transparent rectangular color block behind main text

candidateDirections.reason: Classic high-contrast serif with sharp terminals.
Extreme contrast for a more modern-editorial feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-key portrait of a smiling man with a beard holding an acoustic guitar on a bright white wooden porch. Apply a desaturated, slightly teal-tinted color grade with heavy film grain and grit textures.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add all-caps serif text in the middle-left over a faded cream rectangular block. Add wide-tracked serif text at the bottom center in white.

verificationChecks: Does the text have a weathered, non-digital appearance?
Is the guitar neck creating a strong diagonal?
Is the color palette restricted to teals, creams, and grays?

adjustableVariables: Opacity of the text background block
Tracking width of the bottom text
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Brand logos or specific guitar headstock branding
Exact wording of the original text
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text doesn't look 'stuck on' but part of the scene
Verify the subject's expression is warm and approachable
Confirm the high-contrast serif maintains readability against the grain
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine high-key rustic photography with distressed high-contrast serif typography and a desaturated cool-toned color grade.
